Players Committee errata card image of [[Captain Piett (PC Errata 2018 E card)]], marked "E", as it stood in the [[Holotable]] image set when the PC's GitHub repository [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable swccgpc/holotable] was first committed on 8 July 2018 (commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b]). The PC later replaced it with a "D-E1" image (commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/4dee9a17f7f3e71ba2ae86dc733ede5dd9d5c9ef 4dee9a1], 23 December 2022).

Source: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Hoth-Dark/large/captainpiett.gif Images-HT/starwars/Hoth-Dark/large/captainpiett.gif] at commit 022435b. Uploaded unchanged. SHA-256 <code>420396021150c1309d4c77b948cd3c186142270cab622070fdf44b9477b11ab9</code>.

The card image may be older than 8 July 2018: that is the date of the repository's first commit, which imported the existing image set.

Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata image by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
